import io,sys

from solution import lines

print(list(lines([b"hello\n", b"world"])))
print(list(lines([b"\r\n", b"\r", b"x\r\n"])))
# split multibyte
print(list(lines([b"caf", b"\xc3\xa9\n"])))
# empty lines
print(list(lines([b"\n\nx\n"])))
# unterminated empty
print(list(lines([b""])))
# invalid utf8
for chunks in ([b"caf\xcc"], [b"caf", b"\xc3"], [b"\xff\n"]):
    try:
        print(list(lines(chunks)))
    except UnicodeDecodeError as e:
        print("UnicodeDecodeError", e)
# generator chunks
print(list(lines((c for c in [b"a\n", b"b"]))))
